note: The includeFile argument is attacker-controlled configuration text that becomes the path fragment used in path construction.
The parent config filename is copied into a fixed-size stack buffer before appending the relative include path.
The code assumes the concatenated path still fits in fname, but a long relative include path can exceed the stack buffer capacity.
strlcat writes appended bytes into the destination buffer, overflowing the stack buffer when the combined path is too long.
